sections.heading: MAJOR IN WORLD RELIGIONS AND CULTURES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Religious Studies 1023E is recommended.
2.0 courses from: Religious Studies 2218F/G, Religious Studies 2281F/G, Religious Studies 2283F/G, Religious Studies 2285F/G, Religious Studies 2286F/G.
0.5 course from: Religious Studies 3300F/G, Religious Studies 4400F/G.
2.0 additional courses from: Religious Studies at the 2200 level or above, except Religious Studies 2208U, Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y*.
1.0 additional course from: Religious Studies at the 3000 level or above, except Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y.
* The 2.0 additional courses may include Philosophy 2660E.
